description: This file implements the login feature for users, including data validation, handling authentication logic, verifying credentials, and generating JWT tokens.

classes.name: Login.UserData
classes.description: Data transfer object for user's email and password during login.

classes.name: Login.Command
classes.description: Represents the login command carrying user data, implementing MediatR's IRequest.

classes.name: Login.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validates the login command to ensure email and password are provided.

classes.name: Login.Handler
classes.description: Handles the login command: retrieves user, verifies credentials, and generates JWT token.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Executes the login process: fetches user, checks password, and produces an auth token.
